{{Quote|All right, younglings, stay together now! It won't be long before we've reached our campsite.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Younglings" />}}
This '''unidentified planet''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] took a [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Jedi Initiate Clan]] on a [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] [[Mission to unidentified planet (Younglings)|mission]] to this planet. Members of the group included [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|younglings]] [[Ammon]], [[Cryle]] and [[Tryla (Jedi Initiate)|Tryla]].
